resources.string: These preferences apply to the local viewer, not capture audio, recording gain or media files. Playback requires an explicit Play action. Playback position is not saved in preferences or presets.
Repeat after playback reaches the end
Send paused frames straight to the display

Off by default. The viewer normally converts each paused frame itself so that its colour can be checked. Turn this on if that is slow on this device: frame positions stay exact, but colour follows the system and HDR shows as the display allows. Applies to this device only.
